text:
maria: heads-up: quick docs sweep — found one orphan anchor in /runtime/kv-cache and two images 403 in getting-started. low effort. can anyone grab in next few hours? :wave:
docs-bot: 🚨 docs-scan: 3 dead links found in /runtime/guides (lines: 243, 512) and 2 images returning 403. Report: https://internal.reports/docs-scan/1795555555
josh: @maria I'll take the orphan anchor and push a tiny PR. will link here once ready.
akash: for images, suggest rehost to s3-redirect bucket. quick sed to update paths: `git grep -l 'cdn.oldexample.com' | xargs sed -i 's|cdn.oldexample.com|cdn.canonical.internal|g'`
lia: can help with staging rehost and smoke test after PRs. @josh ping me for review. :thumbsup:
josh: PR: https://git.internal/redwood/docs/pull/4321 — fixes anchor + redirects one shortlink. @lia @maria PTAL, small patch
maria: thanks Josh — moving to 'docs-sprint' lane. @ryan FYI this is low risk; can be hotfixed if needed.
ryan: ok. if it's just anchors/images, no need for canary. recommend merge after one approval.
lia: LGTM on content, left one minor alt-text nit in PR. added a tiny commit. testing staging now.
docs-bot: Deploy bot: staging preview available at https://staging.docs.redwood.ai/runtime/kv-cache#cache-anchors (expires in 2h)
lia: :white_check_mark: staging looks good, images load. @josh you can merge when CI is green.
josh: merging now. thanks all :shipit:
